name: Immunotherapy Induced Hypophysitis

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: No standardized formal criteria; diagnosis based on clinical, biochemical, and imaging findings

criteria.description: Presence of new onset headache and/or symptoms of pituitary hormone deficiency during or after immunotherapy
Biochemical evidence of anterior pituitary hormone deficiencies (e.g., ACTH, TSH, LH/FSH)
MRI showing pituitary enlargement, stalk thickening, or enhancement consistent with hypophysitis
Exclusion of other causes of hypopituitarism such as pituitary adenoma or metastasis

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of clinical symptoms plus biochemical pituitary hormone deficiency and supportive pituitary MRI findings during or after immunotherapy
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical and supported by imaging and laboratory findings in the context of recent immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Central adrenal insufficiency symptoms (e.g., hypotension, fatigue due to ACTH deficiency)
searchTerms: low blood pressure and tiredness from adrenal problems
fatigue due to low adrenal hormones

common.symptomName: Secondary hypothyroidism symptoms (e.g., cold intolerance, constipation)
searchTerms: feeling cold and constipated from low thyroid

common.symptomName: Hyponatremia due to adrenal insufficiency or SIADH
searchTerms: low blood sodium from adrenal issues
salt imbalance due to hormone problems

common.symptomName: Fatigue related to pituitary hormone deficiencies
searchTerms: lack of energy from pituitary problems

common.symptomName: Visual field defects (rarely due to mass effect)

occasional.symptomName: Secondary hypogonadism symptoms (e.g., decreased libido, amenorrhea)
searchTerms: low sex drive and missed periods

occasional.symptomName: Nausea and vomiting from adrenal insufficiency
searchTerms: nausea and vomiting from adrenal failure
stomach upset due to hormone deficiency

occasional.symptomName: Dizziness or syncope due to hypotension
searchTerms: feeling dizzy or faint from low blood pressure

rare.notes: Rare in immunotherapy-induced hypophysitis compared to other forms

rare.symptomName: Seizures secondary to mass effect or electrolyte abnormalities
searchTerms: seizures from brain pressure or electrolyte problems
fits caused by mass effect or chemical imbalance
convulsions due to brain or blood issues

laboratory: Low serum cortisol and ACTH indicating secondary adrenal insufficiency
Low free T4 with low or inappropriately normal TSH indicating secondary hypothyroidism
Low LH and FSH with low sex steroids indicating secondary hypogonadism
Mildly elevated prolactin due to stalk effect
imaging: Pituitary MRI showing diffuse pituitary enlargement
Pituitary stalk thickening and homogeneous enhancement
Absence of focal adenoma or mass lesion
other: Temporal association with immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy (e.g., ipilimumab, nivolumab)
Improvement or stabilization with corticosteroid therapy

distinguishingFeatures: Focal pituitary mass on MRI rather than diffuse enlargement
Usually no systemic immune therapy history
Hormonal hypersecretion syndromes may be present
Known primary malignancy with metastatic spread
Irregular pituitary lesion with possible hemorrhage
Rapid progression and systemic cancer symptoms
Similar MRI findings but different clinical context

redFlags: Rapid visual field loss or ophthalmoplegia
